title: Over C, cup product for two smooth quasi-projective varieties with regular functions is a Kunneth isomorphism strictly compatible with the irregular Hodge filtrations on both exponential twisted de Rham and Higgs cohomology
author: Kai-Chieh Chen; Jeng-Daw Yu
work: The Künneth Formula for the Twisted de Rham and Higgs Cohomologies
source_version: Official SIGMA 14 (2018) article 055, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2018.055; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: Ordinary Kunneth does not identify the irregular Hodge filtration after adding the two exponential potentials, because the product compactification can develop indeterminacy. The author constructs explicit blowups controlled by relative pole orders and compares the filtered complexes at every step. Local monomial sheaf quotients, exceptional-divisor acyclicity and the convolution filtration together prove strict filtered compatibility for both differentials.

Prior E1 degeneration, good-compactification invariance and coherent-sheaf Kunneth remain explicitly cited standard prerequisites. The separate Brieskorn-bundle infinity-fiber issue is not selected. No support proposition is counted separately. proof_review.note: Complete Sections2-3 author proofs were read. The author supplies local nondegenerate-compactification Kontsevich bases, exact quotient complexes and explicit zero/pole blowup charts to extend compactification invariance. For the product he constructs a terminating sequence of pole-order-comparison blowups, then identifies the initial convolution filtration, proves filtered cohomology injectivity by E1 degeneration and coherent-sheaf Kunneth, and computes every exceptional quotient as relative O(-1). The monomial-ideal filtration and projection formula complete the filtered pushforward comparison. Prior E1 degeneration, good-compactification invariance and coherent-sheaf Kunneth are established background. The distinct Brieskorn-bundle fiber-at-infinity questions are not included.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Full Theorem1 for two smooth quasi-projective varieties U_i over C and regular functions f_i. On U_1 times U_2 take f=f_1+f_2. For each nonnegative k, cup product from the direct sum H^i(U_1,f_1) tensor H^j(U_2,f_2), i+j=k, is an isomorphism with the tensor-product rational-indexed irregular Hodge filtration, for both d+df and wedge df. The filtrations are exactly those constructed through nondegenerate compactifications in Section2. No assertion of the analogous Kunneth formula at the infinity fiber of the Brieskorn lattice is made.
